item.title: Leadership changes in Minnesota follow tensions among agencies over immigration enforcement tactics
item.description: The Trump administration’s immigration operation in Minnesota is now being unified under U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

item.title: Utah, France and Italy sign agreement to cooperate on future Olympic Games
item.description: Representatives from Utah, France and Italy signed a memorandum of agreement on Friday.

item.title: Person gets on UTA TRAX train in Salt Lake City after being stabbed
item.description: A person who was stabbed on Saturday got on a TRAX train in Salt Lake City before receiving help.

item.title: UHP trooper injured in Murray crash with alleged DUI driver
item.description: A Utah Highway Patrol trooper was taken to the hospital for non-life threatening injuries after a crash in Murray.

item.title: What is atrial fibrillation and how is it treated?
item.description: Atrial fibrillation, or A-fib, is becoming more common, but doctors say treatments are improving.

item.title: Epstein revelations have toppled top figures in Europe while US fallout is more muted
item.description: The Jeffrey Epstein files have rocked Europe's elite, revealing ties to a prince, an ambassador, and top politicians. The U.S. Department of Justice released documents that have ended careers and sparked investigations.

item.title: Appeals court affirms Trump policy of jailing immigrants without bond
item.description: A federal appeals court has ruled that President Donald Trump's administration can continue detaining immigrants without bond.

item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in desperate video plea to potential kidnappers of her mother
item.description: Savannah Guthrie has told the potential kidnappers of her mother Nancy Guthrie that the family is prepared to pay for her safe return.

item.title: Can apes play pretend? Scientists use an imaginary tea party to find out
item.description: Humans have often considered how apes, our closest living genetic relatives, possess human-like characteristics and behaviors — and their similarities to us might be closer than we imagined.

item.title: Israel says Netanyahu will meet with Trump on Wednesday about Iran talks
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will meet with U.S. President Donald Trump in Washington on Wednesday about the U.S. talks with Iran.
